cases.sentence: В десятом году, в двенадцатый день ___ было ко мне слово Господа:
cases.explain: «десятого месяца» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: In the tenth year, in the tenth month, on the twelfth day of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

cases.explain: «безлюдной пустыней» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: The land of Egypt will be a desolation and a waste. Then they will know that I am Yahweh. “ ‘ “Because he has said, ‘The river is mine, and I have made it;’

cases.sentence: Я сделаю землю Египта мертвой пустыней от Мигдола до Сиены, до ___ с Кушем.
cases.explain: «самой границы» — after the preposition «до», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The land of Egypt will be a desolation and a waste. Then they will know that I am Yahweh. “ ‘ “Because he has said, ‘The river is mine, and I have made it;’

cases.sentence: Я рассею египтян между ___ и развею их по чужим землям.
cases.explain: «другими народами» — after the preposition «между», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: I will make the land of Egypt a desolation in the middle of the countries that are desolate. Her cities among the cities that are laid waste will be a desolation forty years. I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.”

cases.sentence: Я рассею египтян между другими народами и развею их по ___.
cases.explain: «чужим землям» — after the preposition «по», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: I will make the land of Egypt a desolation in the middle of the countries that are desolate. Her cities among the cities that are laid waste will be a desolation forty years. I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.”

cases.sentence: Они будут там ___, 15 самым слабым из царств, и никогда впредь не возвысятся над другими народами.
cases.explain: «слабым царством» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: I will reverse the captivity of Egypt, and will cause them to return into the land of Pathros, into the land of their birth. They will be a lowly kingdom, there.

cases.sentence: Они будут там слабым царством, 15 самым слабым из царств, и никогда впредь не возвысятся над ___.
cases.explain: «другими народами» — after the preposition «над», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: I will reverse the captivity of Egypt, and will cause them to return into the land of Pathros, into the land of their birth. They will be a lowly kingdom, there.

cases.sentence: В двадцать седьмом году, в первый день ___ было ко мне слово Господне:
cases.explain: «первого месяца» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: It came to pass in the twenty-seventh year, in the first month, in the first day of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

cases.sentence: — Сын человеческий, Навуходоносор, царь Вавилона, заставил свое войско немало потрудиться под Тиром: все головы оплешивели, все плечи натерты от ___.
cases.explain: «непосильного труда» — after the preposition «от», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: “Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyre. Every head was made bald, and every shoulder was worn; yet he had no wages, nor did his army, from Tyre, for the service that he had served against it.
